
Re-lands the evidence-freshness corrections on the current master line.

The semantic-trace harness now fails closed when it cannot establish that a discovered or explicit binary is newer than every readable client source file. The PR-body checker rejects measured evidence figures and requires commands that a reviewer can rerun at the current head.

Evidence commands:
- `git diff --check origin/master...HEAD`
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- `python tools/generate_messages.py --check`
- `python tools/generate_protocol_constants.py --check`
- `python tests/test_semantic_trace.py --require -v`
- `ctest --test-dir client/build --output-on-failure`
